card.name: Kidney terms: eGFR and section numbers
card.fires_on: The letter e starting eGFR (estimated glomerular filtration rate) in kidney function statements. Also fires on digits inside section numbers or day counts, and on pieces of FSGS in kidney disease settings.

modes.label: eGFR start
modes.description: The lowercase e that begins eGFR after estimated glomerular filtration rate or before a cutoff.
modes.example: Increases in serum creatinine levels and decreases in estimated glomerular filtration rate (<<e>>GFR) have been reported during treatment

modes.label: Section or day numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a cross-reference like (2.4) or a day count.

modes.label: FSGS letters
modes.description: Letters inside the abbreviation FSGS, a kidney disease, in dosing text.
modes.example: in patients with IgAN or F<<SG>>S after an interruption

card.writes: It suppresses kidney-related word starts such as ren, neph and N, so it appears to dampen kidney-word continuations after these pieces.
card.plain: It fires on the start of eGFR and nearby kidney-dosing numbers and abbreviations in drug labels.
